# GEO report: harbor-site

**New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics.

## Code score: 40/100, At risk

Confidence: High (checked 25 of 25 points).
How it's calculated: low = 16.33 ÷ 25 × 100 = 65. High = (16.33 + 0) ÷ 25 × 100 = 65. Both are capped at 40 because the blocker on GEO-009 applies: two search crawlers are blocked from the whole site.

There are no `geo.config.json` and no declared policy, so I assumed you want AI search tools to find this site. That assumption is what triggers the cap. Without the cap the score would be 65. Nothing came out as Can't tell, because the whole site is static Astro and I read all of it. I sampled 3 routes: `/`, `/moorings` and `/contact`.

## Live check

**Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL.

## Do these first

### 1. Unblock the AI search crawlers
- **Why it matters:** `OAI-SearchBot` (ChatGPT search) and `PerplexityBot` are told to stay off the whole site, so those tools can't read it. If this is deliberate, say so in `geo.config.json` (`policy.aiSearchCrawlers`).
- **Where:** `public/robots.txt:4-8`
- **What the code says:** `User-agent: OAI-SearchBot` / `Disallow: /` and `User-agent: PerplexityBot` / `Disallow: /`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** 77 (the cap lifts, and GEO-009 earns 3 more points)

### 2. Fix the two broken JSON-LD blocks
- **Why it matters:** Structured data is a label telling machines what a page is. Both labels here are broken, so they'd be ignored.
- **Where:** `src/data/faq.json:8` and `src/pages/index.astro:9`
- **What the code says:** `" ": {` (it should be `"acceptedAnswer"`), and `"headline": "Moorings and prices", }` (the trailing comma makes the JSON invalid)
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** Still 40 while item 1 is undone, because the cap holds. Uncapped it would be 73. With items 1 and 2 together it is 85.

### 3. Give each page its own canonical
- **Why it matters:** A canonical link names a page's main address. Every page here says its main address is the home page, which tells search engines to treat `/moorings` and `/contact` as duplicates of `/`.
- **Where:** `src/layouts/Base.astro:8`
- **What the code says:** `<link rel="canonical" href="https://harbor.example/" />`
- **Size:** Small
- **Score after this:** Still 40 while item 1 is undone. Uncapped it would be 70. With item 1 as well it is 82.

## All results

| Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and within limits | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`. It is plain text and uses valid lines. |
| GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you intend | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:4-8`. Site-wide, so it earns 0 of 3. GPTBot and ClaudeBot (training crawlers) aren't mentioned, so they're allowed by default. |
| GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | `src/pages/contact.astro:4` has `robots="noindex"`, but the page is in `public/sitemap.xml:5` and in the nav (`src/layouts/Base.astro:12`). 1 of 3 routes has the problem, so it earns 2 of 3. |
| GEO-015 | Canonical is absolute and correct per page | Problem | Not run | `src/layouts/Base.astro:8`. Only `/` is right; `/moorings` and `/contact` are wrong. It earns 0.67 of 2. |
| GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Clear | Not run | Astro renders static HTML. `Newsletter client:load` is also server-rendered first. |
| GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid and complete | Problem | Not run | `src/data/faq.json:8` and `src/pages/index.astro:9`. Both routes that have JSON-LD are broken, so it earns 0. |
| GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is linked from robots.txt | Clear | Not run | `public/sitemap.xml`, and the `Sitemap:` line at `public/robots.txt:10`. |
| GEO-012 | Title, description and lang are present | Clear | Not run | `src/layouts/Base.astro:4-7`, and each page passes distinct values. |
| GEO-016 | Pages are reachable by real links | Clear | Not run | `src/layouts/Base.astro:12` uses plain `<a href>`. |
| GEO-017 | Snippet limits don't conflict with AI search | Problem | Not run | `src/layouts/Base.astro:9` has `max-snippet:0` as the default. `/` and `/moorings` are hit, and `/contact` overrides it. It earns 0.67 of 2. |
| GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Clear | Not run | I read `Newsletter.jsx` and `Base.astro`. The input has a label, the button has text, and there are no images. |
| GEO-101 | Mobile app files | Not applicable | Not run | No app is declared. |
| GEO-010 | llms.txt (informational) | Not applicable | Not run | No `llms.txt` file, and not scored. |
| GEO-102 | App structured data (informational) | Not applicable | Not run | Not an app, and not scored. |

## Other problems found

- **Page-wide `max-snippet:0` is the layout default.** `src/layouts/Base.astro:9` has `content={robots ?? "max-snippet:0"}`. Any new page that doesn't pass `robots` also blocks quoting. Remove the default, or use `index, follow`. This is the cause of GEO-017.
- **The noindex page is in the sitemap.** `public/sitemap.xml:5` has `<loc>https://harbor.example/contact</loc>`. Either remove it from the sitemap or drop the `noindex`.

## Worth considering

- **FAQ answers exist only inside a script:** `src/pages/moorings.astro:8`: `<script type="application/ld+json" set:html={JSON.stringify(faq)}>`. The page never shows these questions as visible text. Rendering them on the page might help readers and machines.
- **The description promises content the page lacks:** `src/pages/index.astro:5`: `description="Mooring sizes and seasonal prices."`, but the page only says `Prices start at £40 a night.` Adding a sizes and prices table would back up the promise.
- **Contact page leaves out the email:** `src/pages/contact.astro:4`: `description="Phone and email for the harbour office."`, but the body only has `Call the harbour office on 01326 000000.` Add the email address, or fix the description.
- **The harbour's details could be labelled:** `src/pages/contact.astro:6` has a phone number and `moorings.astro:6` has the Falmouth location. `LocalBusiness` structured data could label these.
- **The head is missing basics:** `src/layouts/Base.astro:5-10` has no `charset` or `viewport` meta tag, and the body has no `<main>`.
- **Spelling is inconsistent:** "Harbor" in `src/pages/moorings.astro:5` against "harbour" in `src/pages/contact.astro:4`. Pick one, since people search with one spelling.
- **No site URL is set for Astro:** there is no `astro.config` file. Setting `site` would let the framework build canonicals and sitemaps correctly.

## Can't tell from code

- **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs <access log>` to check real crawlers against their published addresses.
- **Server response codes and headers:** `X-Robots-Tag`, redirects and the real status of `/robots.txt` are decided by hosting, not by this repo. A live scan would confirm them.

## Assumptions

- You want AI search tools (OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot) to find this site. If the blocks are deliberate, the cap and GEO-009 would change.
- `https://harbor.example` is a placeholder. I treated it as the intended origin because every file uses it consistently.

## What to do next

1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written.
2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more.
3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL.

Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
